verdict.rationale: The evidence never documents a way for a RudderStack user to opt out of RudderStack's own telemetry or usage tracking, whether in the cloud app, the open-source server, or the SDKs. Consent Management and the compliance toolkit exist so RudderStack customers can capture *their end-users'* consent and suppress *their* data downstream. That is an adjacent feature, not an opt-out from the product's own telemetry. Self-hosting the open-source version or storing data on your own infrastructure likewise does not show a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
